croak.definition:
n. a harsh hoarse utterance (as of a frog)
v. utter a hoarse sound, like a raven
croak.translation:
n. 呱呱叫声, 哇哇声
vi. 呱呱地叫, 发牢骚
vt. 用嘶哑的声音说

croaked.translation: v. 呱呱地叫( croak的过去式和过去分词 ); 用粗的声音说

croaker.definition:
n. the lean flesh of a saltwater fish caught along Atlantic coast of southern U.S.
n. any of several fishes that make a croaking noise
croaker.translation: n. 呱呱叫的动物, 黄花鱼, 预报凶事者, 发牢骚者, 鸣冤者, 悲观者

croakers.definition:
plural of croaker
n. the lean flesh of a saltwater fish caught along Atlantic coast of southern U.S.
n. any of several fishes that make a croaking noise
croakers.translation: (croaker 的复数) n. 呱呱叫的动物, 黄花鱼, 预报凶事者, 发牢骚者, 鸣冤者, 悲观者

croaking.definition:
n a harsh hoarse utterance (as of a frog)
v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
v utter a hoarse sound, like a raven
v make complaining remarks or noises under one's breath
croaking.translation: v. 呱呱地叫( croak的现在分词 ); 用粗的声音说

croaks.definition:
n a harsh hoarse utterance (as of a frog)
v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
v utter a hoarse sound, like a raven
v make complaining remarks or noises under one's breath
croaks.translation: v. 呱呱地叫( croak的第三人称单数 ); 用粗的声音说

croaky.definition: s. like the sounds of frogs and crows

croasdale.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 克罗斯代尔来源于古诺斯语，含义是“十字形+山谷”(cross+valley)

croat.definition: n a member of the Slavic people living in Croatia
croat.translation: n. 克罗地亚人；克罗地亚语

croatan.translation: n. 克洛坦族（印第安人之一族）

croatia.definition: n. a republic in the western Balkans in south-central Europe in the eastern Adriatic coastal area; formerly part of the Habsburg monarchy and Yugoslavia; became independent in 1991

croatian.definition:
n. a member of the Slavic people living in Croatia
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Croatia or its people or language
croatian.translation:
a. 克罗地亚的, 克罗地亚语的, 克罗地亚人的
n. 克罗地亚人, 克罗地亚语

croatians.definition: n. a member of the Slavic people living in Croatia
croatians.translation:
a. 克罗地亚的；克罗地亚人的
n. 克罗地亚人；塞尔维亚—克罗地亚语

croats.definition: n. a member of the Slavic people living in Croatia
croats.translation: n. 克罗地亚人（Croat的复数）
